purpose: Supporting evidence for CORRECTIONS.md entries C6-C12, produced without any new image generation or GPU computation (JSON re-derivation, full-resolution re-inspection of existing images, and one CPU-only tokenizer check).

c6_persisted_degenerate_fix.bug: Published evidence/reference_A_intervention/VISUAL_REVIEW.json's AtoB_M0_reference_to_AB_REF_A.persisted_degenerate array included cases 28,29,30,31, which are also listed in that same table's recovered array -- a case cannot be both.
c6_persisted_degenerate_fix.note: This fix is independent of the C7 re-adjudication below; it is a pure listing-contradiction fix under the ORIGINALLY PUBLISHED labels.

c7_re_adjudication.method: Independent full-resolution re-inspection of cases 28, 29, 30, 31, 33 (the five cases the published report called non-degenerate), applying the existing degeneration rubric with the explicit reminder that recognizable foreground content alone does not establish a usable image. Performed without being told which verdict to reach; recorded as found, including disagreement with the previously published labels and with an external characterization of case 30.

28.description: Pink/red glove and arm reaching upward; background is a regular tree-branch/rigging pattern against sky.
28.uncertainty: low — background pattern reads as plausible foliage/rigging, not the chaotic small-square mesh signature seen in clearly-degenerate cases

29.description: Coherent hand occupies the lower-right ~40% of frame; the remaining ~60% (upper-left/upper-right) shows the same honeycomb/mesh corruption artifact as the degenerate majority, plus an indistinct ghost second hand shape and unnatural dark banding across the main hand itself.
29.uncertainty: low — majority-of-frame corruption is directly visible, not a borderline call

30.description: Coherent hand/arm in sharp focus; blurred green background carries a faint, localized, regular diamond-grid texture.
30.uncertainty: explicit and unresolved — this faint background texture could be the same artifact family at low amplitude or could be ordinary depth-of-field bokeh; this review could not resolve which, and disagrees with an external characterization of this case as comparable to 29/33 in severity

31.description: Coherent hand; mostly smooth green-blur background with one anomalous horizontal line artifact.
31.uncertainty: low — single minor artifact, not pervasive corruption

33.description: A small coherent face/arm fragment occupies roughly the bottom-left 15-20% of the frame; the remaining ~80-85% is the same mesh/mosaic corruption pattern seen throughout the clearly-degenerate golf-ball cases.
33.uncertainty: low — this is a near-textbook match to the existing degeneration rubric ('substantial incoherence, corruption... preventing a usable image'); the published non-degenerate label was a reviewer error on this case specifically

atob_to_abrefa_reviewed.net_change_vs_atob: +2 (3 recovered - 1 newly damaged), down from the originally published +4

c9_norm_decomposition.formula: cos(theta) = (N1^2 + N2^2 - D^2) / (2*N1*N2), with N1,N2 the two embedding norms and D the difference-vector norm
c9_norm_decomposition.interpretation: The 22.12% relative-difference figure is overwhelmingly directional (~12.70 degrees of angle), not a scale/magnitude effect (0.0399%). No GPU/model computation was used -- pure arithmetic on already-saved norms.

run_reference_A_intervention_py_checks.assert_full_storage_separation: enforced -- raises RuntimeError on any shared-storage tensor
run_reference_A_intervention_py_checks.assert_reference_unchanged: enforced -- raises RuntimeError on any changed reference tensor
run_reference_A_intervention_py_checks.changed_keys_equal_expected_32_check: NOT enforced -- computed as a boolean and stored in the result dict; no assert/raise. A mismatch would have been logged as false and execution would have continued.
run_reference_A_intervention_py_checks.actual_outcome: the logged boolean was true (32/32 match) in both the Phase-1 replay and Phase-2 AB_REF_A build -- no violation occurred, but the check as implemented could not have stopped one

c11_token_suffix_measurement.formula: slice_length = L - max(i, j), where i = old_text final_token_idx, j = new_text final_token_idx, L = tokenizer padded length
c11_token_suffix_measurement.method: CPU-only CLIPTokenizer check against the pinned SD1.4 snapshot tokenizer, no GPU, no image generation.
c11_token_suffix_measurement.interpretation: For this experiment's actual concept, the preliminary-UCE suffix slice spans 75 of 77 token positions -- nearly the entire padded sequence, not a narrow or single-token slice. C5's 'often one token wide in practice' aside was incorrect and is retracted by C11.
